name: FestivalSubmissionsManager
tagline: Plan the festival run, hit every deadline and protect every premiere.
description: A complete film festival submissions app in one PCF control: shortlist festivals per film, track early/regular/late deadlines, entry fees and waivers against a per-film budget, move entries through the submission pipeline, protect World/International/Regional/National premieres with automatic conflict checks, and record decisions, screenings and awards. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Deadline rules – submit blocked after the deadline
Entry-fee budget per film with waivers
Drag & drop pipeline with allowed transitions
Deadline, decision, festival and screening calendar
Phone layout with bottom view bar
